fusions.name: Pounce from Nowhere
fusions.desc: Leaps at an enemy up to 8 tiles away and deals 26 piercing damage, rising to 2.5 times that at 8 tiles. It ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Skittish Nip
fusions.desc: Bites an enemy and deals 4 piercing damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each bite has a 25% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Across the Room
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away and raises your dodge chance by 15% for the moment you land.

fusions.name: Never Where It Was
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
